subject: Substrate isolation narrative & evidence onboarding for SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ
messages:
From: Alex Montero <alex.montero@zenbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: isolation provenance + CAIQ/SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Jordan / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As a follow-up, our compliance team asked for an "isolation provenance" package that demonstrates how Redwood controls tenant isolation across Dedicated and Private deployment modes. Specifically they're looking for:

- A short architectural narrative (1-2 pages) that explains the isolation model at a substrate level (what we call the "control substrate").
- Network diagrams that show separation between control plane, data plane, and tenant compute in both Dedicated (multi-tenant pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem) modes.
- A mapping of relevant SIG/CAIQ controls to concrete artifacts (e.g., diagrams, runbooks, firewall rules, KMS boundaries).
- List of evidence files and point-owners for each artifact.

We have a SOC 2 review scheduled for 2028-07-21 and need deliverables by 2028-07-10 to give our auditors time. Can you confirm you can provide a draft package and who on your side will own each piece?

I've attached a short PDF with the auditors' ask and a template they prefer for CAIQ mappings (zenbridge-sig-q3-ask.pdf).

Appreciate it — let me know if the date is tight.

Thanks,
Alex
Security Lead — ZenBridge Analytics

Attachment: zenbridge-sig-q3-ask.pdf (1 page)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Montero <alex.montero@zenbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation provenance + CAIQ/SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can provide a compact "substrate isolation dossier" that maps directly to SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ controls and includes the diagrams and ownership list. Plan and owners below: 

Deliverables (target draft by 2028-07-08):
- Substrate isolation narrative (2 pages) — owner: Jordan Blake (Architecture)
- Combined network diagrams: Dedicated pools & Private (VPC/on-prem) — owner: Marissa Cole (Network/Infra)
- CAIQ/SIG control mapping spreadsheet populated with artifact references — owner: Kimberly Park (Compliance)
- Evidence bundle (runbooks, firewall rule exports, KMS scopes, audit-log samples) — owner: Soojin Lee (SecOps)
- Short runbook extract showing canary/eviction flow for tenant containment — owner: Marissa Cole

Key points we'll emphasize in the narrative (so auditors see distinct boundaries):
- Control substrate concept: logical layers (orchestration, control plane services, tenant compute), physical/VM level segregation, and per-tenant KV-cache isolation.
- Network separation: clear ACLs between control plane and tenant compute; private deployments leverage customer VPC routing and our sidecar/egress proxies; Dedicated uses reserved GPU pools with strict egress and intra-pool segmentation.
- KMS boundaries and access controls for model artifacts and logs — key scoping and HSM usage where applicable.

Attachments included here: substrate_isolation_manifest_v1.pdf (initial narrative stub) and a preliminary owners spreadsheet. We'll populate the CAIQ template you provided and share a Drive folder link by tomorrow EOD.

Questions for you:
1) Do auditors need raw firewall configuration files, or consolidated rule exports and annotated screenshots will suffice?
2) Any specific SIG questions your team flagged as high-priority so we can prioritize artifact collection?

I'll coordinate offline with the owners and start assembling artifacts.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: substrate_isolation_manifest_v1.pdf; redwood-segmentation-owners.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation provenance + CAIQ/SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Team —

Thanks Jordan. Quick coordination note and ownersheet with next steps:

Evidence checklist (owner / ETA):
- Network diagrams (Marissa) — annotated SVG + PNG (2028-07-05)
- Control-plane service list + deployment boundary table (Jordan) — include service names, ports, and minimal access assertions (2028-07-05)
- Firewall rule export (Sooj) — consolidated CSV + one raw config for auditor review (2028-07-06)
- KMS key policy excerpts and usage map (Sooj) — show tenants vs. platform keys (2028-07-06)
- Tenant eviction runbook excerpt and test log sample (Marissa) — include timeline, alerts, and post-mitigation verification (2028-07-07)
- CAIQ mapping (Kimberly) — populate with references to the above artifacts (2028-07-08)

I've created a shared Drive folder and set permissions for Alex's team (link below). Please stage outputs there; name files with the prefix "ZENBRIDGE_" for audit traceability.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefG-substrate-evidence

Sooj — for the firewall export, auditors sometimes ask for both the raw device config and an annotated rule dump. If we can provide one raw snapshot plus a simplified CSV where we tag rules relevant to tenant separation, that should be efficient.

Marissa — ping me if you want compliance to redact any internal hostnames before upload; we'll keep an unredacted archive for legal.

Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-segmentation-owners.xlsx
From: Alex Montero <alex.montero@zenbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation provenance + CAIQ/SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Jordan / Kimberly / Team —

Appreciate the quick plan and owners. That timeline works for us — getting a draft by 2028-07-08 is acceptable. A few clarifications: 

- For firewall artifacts, annotated rule dumps + one raw snapshot is perfect. No need for every historical raw file.
- For KMS excerpts, a policy copy showing key scoping and a short note about HSM-backed keys is enough.
- Please include an access matrix that shows which Redwood roles can perform tenant-eviction or key-rotation operations.

Could you share the Drive folder link and add me as a viewer? Also, if you can create a single CAIQ tab that highlights the high-risk controls (we'll mark priority during review), that will speed the auditor review.
